answer_1.quote: We apply FACTTRACK to the task of detecting contradictions in story outline generation... We employ an outline generator similar to the detailed outliner... using 90 premises from the WritingPrompts dataset and also evaluated on the ContraDoc dataset.
answer_1.outputs: Generated story outlines (long-form text) and contradiction detection scores per event pair

answer_2.quote: We evaluate methods by the average contradiction score in detected pairs—a higher score indicates better detection.

answer_3.quote: For event pairs flagged by a method as contradictory, we use GPT-4 to annotate whether they are actually contradictory, on a 1 to 5 scale.

answer_4.quote: We initially attempted human annotation but found the task to be highly challenging... we use the most advanced version of GPT-4 to complete all annotation tasks.
